Title: Authorizes the city of Schenectady to discontinue the use as parkland and transfer control of the Woodlawn Preserve; relates to the membership of the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission
Summary: Authorizes the city of Schenectady, county of Schenectady, to discontinue the use as parkland and transfer the lands known as the Woodlawn Preserve to the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission to be made part of the Albany Pine Bush preserve and to be under the control of the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission; adds the mayor of Schenectady to the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to the membership of the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission; and to authorize the city of Schenectady, county of Schenectady, to discontinue the use as parkland and transfer control of the Woodlawn Preserve to the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission;
